yt_title: Hank's G 500 has three locking diffs. Here's the catch.

scenes.caption: Most 4x4s have one locker, or none. This has three.
scenes.voice: Lots of four by fours have one locking differential, or none. Hank's G 500 has three.

scenes.caption: Lock all three and every wheel is driven
scenes.voice: Front, center and rear. Lock all three, and every wheel gets driven, even with one hanging in the air.

scenes.caption: On an old G, they often don't work
scenes.voice: The catch? Lockers that were never used often don't work. Hank's still working through his.

scenes.caption: Test every locker on the drive
scenes.voice: The usual fix is finding a vacuum leak, then bleeding the hydraulic lines. So test every one before you buy.

end.sub: Every year, what to check, what it costs:
end.voice: How to check the lockers, and every G 500 year, is on boxy trucks dot com.
